development_provenance.protocol_amendment: OE-LPV-1: prospectively allow recorded actuator limiting in this development integration. Require valid finite local fits, applied input/response bounds and settling for every cell. Preserve the historical zero-limiter gate failure. No cell exclusion by reference accuracy, no filter prerequisite, no claim of smooth acquisition.

protocol.primary_endpoint: Equal-client mean relative Frobenius A/B error on recipient-unobserved speeds; independent paired fleet differences baseline minus Federated. Two Bonferroni 97.5% two-sided Student-t intervals, simultaneous family 95%. Both lower bounds positive and all ten valid equivalent primary fits required.
protocol.failure_policy: No cell/fleet exclusion, replacement seeds, retuning, clipping, or global fallback. Failed fits or applied-bound/settling violations block the affected condition for the whole fleet. Report all failures; incomplete primary set cannot support confirmation.
protocol.amendment: OE-LPV-2: authorize the ten reserved fleets with identical development acquisition and estimation. Recorded actuator limiting allowed with known applied steering, applied bounds and settling required. Historical zero-limiter gate remains failed. No filtering prerequisite.
protocol.scope: Independent confirmation of identification and LPV sharing only; no controller-benefit claim. Clean-state fits, seven strengths, family labels and full-reference fits remain secondary diagnostics.
